about.title: About Velvet Companions
about.lede: Velvet Companions is the Romanian studio that produces and operates rentals of premium realistic companions, with clinical hygiene standards and an unconditional discretion policy.

pillars.heading: Why we started
pillars.body: Born from a private workshop in 2024, the brand appeared as a response to a concrete problem: the European market for realistic companions was polarised between low-cost products with questionable materials and bespoke pieces with six-month lead times. We wanted a middle path — controlled manufacturing, an option to test through rental, and support in three languages for a regional market until now served only from outside the EU.

pillars.heading: What we do differently
pillars.body:
Every model we rent or sell passes through an internal technical evaluation on 14 criteria — from joint tolerances to skin resistance to solvents. The rejection rate is between 20% and 30% per batch. Models that enter the catalogue are then photographed in natural light, without retouching, so there are no surprises at delivery.

Between rentals every companion goes through a five-step hygiene protocol documented per cycle. Buyers receive the same level of preparation plus 12 months of technical support for the internal skeleton and 6 months for the outer skin.

pillars.heading: Who we work for
pillars.body: Our clients are mostly adults between 30 and 55, with stable incomes, who value discretion above price. The majority of enquiries come from Romania, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. Our working languages are Romanian, English and Dutch — each adviser is fluent in at least two.
